I stayed at Stay Hotel and overall my experience was very good. The room was clean, well-maintained, and comfortable. Housekeeping was done on time and hygiene was properly maintained.

The staff was polite, supportive, and quick to help whenever needed. Check-in and check-out process was smooth and hassle-free. The hotel atmosphere was calm and suitable for both family and solo stay.

Location is convenient, with easy access to nearby markets and transport. Food quality was decent; breakfast options were limited but fresh.

Overall: Stay Hotel is a good choice for a comfortable and budget-friendly stay. I would recommend it to others.

The staff was very polite and professional. They also served good food and the room was grand and neatly kept. Furthermore, the location is very close to the metro station, making travel very convenient. All in all, I had a very pleasant stay here and this will definitely be one of my go to hotels in Delhi.

I stayed at The Bed and Rock in Kalkaji and had a wonderful experience. The staff were very friendly and welcoming, which made my stay comfortable. The room was spacious, clean, and well maintained. The food was good, and the surroundings were pleasant and peaceful. Overall, it is a great place to stay, and I highly recommend it.
